themes.name: Daydream
themes.author: Yapfast
themes.description: A Frutiger-Aero daydream: frosted glass panes floating over a sunny sky of drifting cumulus, glossy gel-blue buttons, bubble chat, water-drop sounds and a bubbly icon pack. Night brings a moonlit sky of stars and silver-edged clouds.

themes.name: Phosphor
themes.author: Yapfast
themes.description: A terminal IRC client on warm green phosphor: a timestamped log with a nick column, directory-tree channels, a `$ who` nick list, a block-caret input line, box-drawn panes, a soft glow and a tube that warms up. Pings in amber; pictures dithered in phosphor greens.

themes.name: Hurt
themes.author: Yapfast
themes.description: hurt.bio as a chat app: a near-black room with faint oxblood light and a fading grid, film grain, blackletter names lit red, titles that decrypt, a spinning record for home, sharp icons, vinyl needle-drops and dry clicks. Dark only.

themes.name: Zine
themes.author: Yapfast
themes.description: A punk zine off a two-drum risograph: torn, taped scraps pasted crooked with hard riso shadows, ransom-note names from eight typefaces, typewriter text, a masking-tape hover bar, rubber stamps, scissor-cut icons and paper sounds. Light, or inverted as a black photocopy.

themes.name: Bubblegum
themes.author: Yapfast
themes.description: A pastel handheld console of our own design: a pink-to-lilac plastic shell with a star D-pad, candy face keys, a power LED and speaker slots, a mint LCD inset in a plum bezel with a pixel grid, candy hover bar, holographic player cards, chunky pixel icons and 8-bit blips. Light only.

themes.name: Eyeliner
themes.author: Yapfast
themes.description: Pink-and-black profile-page era with e-girl finish: boxed modules on a collage of crosses, hearts, bats and bokeh, glowing blackletter, magenta bars, blinkie stamps, a liner highlighter, marker icons and glitter chimes. Dark only.

themes.name: System24
themes.author: MisterPotato19
themes.description: system24: square-panel TUI theme with labels and DM Mono.
